svg.aria-label: Three projections of the same Kelvin–Voigt teaching model. Matching colors mark cycle positions 0, 90, 180, and 270 degrees; lines sample the analytic functions. E = 20 kPa, η = 4 kPa·s, f = 0.25 Hz, and strain amplitude is 5%.
